Causal Chain

Joseph Outa

2025-12-18

1 ReadMe

  • Study name: Causal chain
  • Research question: Do subjects use direct causes for causal chain, and latent causes for common causes
  • Design: Between-subjects, causal chain condition vs common cause condition
  • Independent variable: choice of middle item in causal chain vs common cause
  • Dependent variable: proportion choosing similar vs causal item
  • Date study ran: 12/18/25 (105N pilot)
  • Some descriptive stats: N of study 105, N per condition (causal_chain = .., common_cause = ..), Mean age (42y)
  • Location of relevant accessory files: codebook (/code/codebooks), pre-registration (/preregistration)

2.2 Global variables

base_path <- here("code", "main")

data_path <- paste0(base_path, "/data/causal-chain/JO-mbc-main-cc-v2-105N")

snapshots_input_path_distances <- paste0(base_path,
                                         "/analysis/study1-measure-main-and-pilot/snapshots_study1_main_analysis")

distances_path <- paste0(snapshots_input_path_distances,
                                   "/freesort_minus_causals.csv")

desired_order <- c("see something", "choose what to do", "remember something", 
                   "sit down", "jump up and down", "take a walk", 
                   "get tired", "become hungry", "get sick")

2.3 Read data

file_paths <- list.files(path = data_path, pattern = "^2025-", full.names = TRUE)

d <- imap_dfr(file_paths, ~ {
  read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(response = col_character())) %>%
    mutate(
      filename = basename(.x),
      subject_id = paste0("subj_", str_pad(.y, 2, pad = "0"))
    )}) %>%
  select(-c(mturk_participant_id, mturk_assignment_id, mturk_project_id)) %>%
  relocate(subject_id, .before = "success")

3 Wrangle Data

3.1 Wrangle

initial: 30 trials * 48 subjects = 1440 rows. dat: (30 trials / 2 trials per row) * 48 subjects = 720 rows. TODO: rename itemB to target item.

subjects_to_exclude <- d %>%
  filter(grepl("attention_check", condition)) %>% 
  mutate(attn_correct = correct_response_attn == selected_choice) %>% 
  filter(attn_correct == FALSE) %>%
  pull(subject_id) %>% 
  unique()

dat <- d %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("causal_chain", "common_cause")) %>% 
  mutate(response = as.factor(response)) %>% 
  mutate(condition = as.factor(condition)) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(response = case_when(
    grepl(middle_causal, selected_choice) ~ "causal",
    grepl(middle_similar, selected_choice) ~ "similar",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>% 
  select(subject_id, condition, first_item, middle_causal, 
         middle_similar, third_item, response) %>% 
  mutate(domain_first_item = case_when(first_item == "hear something" ~ "mind", 
                                 first_item == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",
                                 first_item == "remember something" ~ "mind",
                                 first_item == "think about something" ~ "mind",
                                 first_item == "see something" ~ "mind",
                                 first_item == "reach for something" ~ "action",
                                 first_item == "sit down" ~ "action", 
                                 first_item == "jump up and down" ~ "action",
                                 first_item == "kick something" ~ "action",
                                 first_item == "take a walk" ~ "action",
                                 first_item == "get tired" ~ "bio", 
                                 first_item == "become hungry" ~ "bio",
                                 first_item == "feel scared"~ "bio",
                                 first_item == "experience pain"~ "bio",
                                 first_item == "get sick"~ "bio"),
         domain_third_item = case_when(third_item == "hear something" ~ "mind", 
                                 third_item == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",
                                 third_item == "remember something" ~ "mind",
                                 third_item == "think about something" ~ "mind",
                                 third_item == "see something" ~ "mind",
                                 third_item == "reach for something" ~ "action",
                                 third_item == "sit down" ~ "action", 
                                 third_item == "jump up and down" ~ "action",
                                 third_item == "kick something" ~ "action",
                                 third_item == "take a walk" ~ "action",
                                 third_item == "get tired" ~ "bio", 
                                 third_item == "become hungry" ~ "bio",
                                 third_item == "feel scared"~ "bio",
                                 third_item == "experience pain"~ "bio",
                                 third_item == "get sick"~ "bio"),
         domain_middle_causal = case_when(middle_causal == "hear something" ~ "mind", 
                                 middle_causal == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",
                                 middle_causal == "remember something" ~ "mind",
                                 middle_causal == "think about something" ~ "mind",
                                 middle_causal == "see something" ~ "mind",
                                 middle_causal == "reach for something" ~ "action",
                                 middle_causal == "sit down" ~ "action", 
                                 middle_causal == "jump up and down" ~ "action",
                                 middle_causal == "kick something" ~ "action",
                                 middle_causal == "take a walk" ~ "action",
                                 middle_causal == "get tired" ~ "bio", 
                                 middle_causal == "become hungry" ~ "bio",
                                 middle_causal == "feel scared"~ "bio",
                                 middle_causal == "experience pain"~ "bio",
                                 middle_causal == "get sick"~ "bio"),
          domain_middle_similar = case_when(middle_similar == "hear something" ~ "mind", 
                                 middle_similar == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",

4 Plot

4.1 Condition difference

dat_summarized <- dat %>%
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("similar", "causal"))) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, response) %>%
  summarize(
    count = n(),  
    total = first(total), 
    mean_proportion = count / total, 
    se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total),  
    .groups = "drop")

main_fig <- dat_summarized %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean_proportion, fill = response)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "#000000")) + 
    geom_errorbar(data = filter(dat_summarized, response == "causal"), aes(ymax = mean_proportion + se,
                                                                           ymin = mean_proportion - se),
                  stat = "identity", position = "identity", width = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_cowplot() +
  labs(y = "Proportion",
       x = "Condition",
       fill = "Response") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 25),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 25),

        panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color = NA),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color = NA),
        
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(1, "cm")
        ) 

main_fig

main_fig <- ggsave("figures/causal_chain-v2.png", width = 6, height = 5, plot = main_fig, bg = "white")

4.3 Item-level

preceding_distances_path <- distances_path

d_distances <- read_csv(distances_path) %>%
  mutate(mean_causal_distance = round(mean_causal_distance, 2),
         mean_freesort_distance = round(mean_freesort_distance, 2),
         freesort_minus_causal = round(freesort_minus_causal, 2))
## Rows: 210 Columns: 7
## ── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ","
## chr (4): itemA, itemB, domain_itemA, domain_itemB
## dbl (3): mean_causal_distance, mean_freesort_distance, freesort_minus_causal
## 
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
dat_summarized_itemlevel <- dat %>%
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("similar", "causal"))) %>%
  unite("first_third", c(first_item, third_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  group_by(condition, first_third) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, first_third, response) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),  
            total = first(total), 
            mean_proportion = round(count / total, 2), 
            se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total),
            .groups = "drop")

dat_labels <- dat %>% 
  unite("first_third", c(first_item, third_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  distinct(first_third, middle_causal, middle_similar) %>% 
  separate(first_third, c("first_item", "third_item"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(d_distances %>% #join causal distances
              rename("third_item" = itemB,
                     "middle_causal" = itemA,
                     "causal_distance_causal_third" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_causal_third" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_causal_third" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(third_item, 
                     middle_causal,
                     causal_distance_causal_third,
                     freesort_distance_causal_third,
                     freesort_minus_causal_causal_third), 
            by = c("third_item", "middle_causal")) %>% 
  left_join(d_distances %>% #join similar distances
              rename("third_item" = itemB,
                     "middle_similar" = itemA,
                     "causal_distance_similar_third" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_similar_third" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_similar_third" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(third_item, 
                     middle_similar,
                     causal_distance_similar_third,
                     freesort_distance_similar_third,
                     freesort_minus_causal_similar_third), 
            by = c("third_item", "middle_similar")) %>% 
  
  left_join(d_distances %>% 
              rename("first_item" = itemA,
                     "middle_causal" = itemB,
                     "causal_distance_causal_first" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_causal_first" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_causal_first" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(first_item, 
                     middle_causal,
                     causal_distance_causal_first,
                     freesort_distance_causal_first,
                     freesort_minus_causal_causal_first), 
            by = c("first_item", "middle_causal")) %>% 
  left_join(d_distances %>% 
              rename("first_item" = itemA,
                     "middle_similar" = itemB,
                     "causal_distance_similar_first" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_similar_first" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_similar_first" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(first_item, 
                     middle_similar,
                     causal_distance_similar_first,
                     freesort_distance_similar_first,
                     freesort_minus_causal_similar_first), 
            by = c("first_item", "middle_similar")) %>% 

  mutate(facet_label = paste0("first item: ", first_item,
                              "\n",
                              "third item: ", third_item,
                              "\n",
                              "causal: ", middle_causal, 
                              "\n",  
                              "similar: ", middle_similar
                              )) 

#sort by itemB and extract the ordered facet labels
ordered_facet_labels <- dat_labels %>%
  mutate(first_item = factor(first_item, levels = desired_order)) %>% 
  arrange(first_item) %>% 
  pull(facet_label)

#join labels + order AFTER labels exist
dat_summarized_itemlevel <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  left_join(dat_labels %>% select(first_third, facet_label), by = "first_third") %>%
  mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_label, levels = ordered_facet_labels))
## Warning in left_join(., dat_labels %>% select(first_third, facet_label), : Detected an unexpected many-to-many relationship between `x` and `y`.
## ℹ Row 1 of `x` matches multiple rows in `y`.
## ℹ Row 5 of `y` matches multiple rows in `x`.
## ℹ If a many-to-many relationship is expected, set `relationship =
##   "many-to-many"` to silence this warning.
#set facet_label as a factor with that order
dat_labels <- dat_labels %>%
  mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_label, levels = ordered_facet_labels))

p_itemlvl <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean_proportion, fill = response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "#000000")) + #or whatever you'd like!
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(dat_summarized_itemlevel, response == "causal"), aes(ymax = mean_proportion + se,
                                                                         ymin = mean_proportion - se),
                stat = "identity", position = "identity", width = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        # legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
  labs(y = "Proportion",
       title = "Causal Chain - pilot, N = 105") +
  facet_wrap(~facet_label, nrow = 3)

p_itemlvl

dat_summarized_itemlevel <- dat %>%
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("similar", "causal"))) %>%
  unite("first_third", c(first_item, third_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  group_by(condition, first_third) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, first_third, response) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),  
            total = first(total), 
            mean_proportion = round(count / total, 2), 
            se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total),
            .groups = "drop")

dat_labels <- dat %>% 
  unite("first_third", c(first_item, third_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  distinct(first_third, middle_causal, middle_similar) %>% 
  separate(first_third, c("first_item", "third_item"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(d_preceding_distances %>% #join causal distances
              rename("third_item" = itemB,
                     "middle_causal" = itemA,
                     "causal_distance_causal_third" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_causal_third" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_causal_third" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(third_item, 
                     middle_causal,
                     causal_distance_causal_third,
                     freesort_distance_causal_third,
                     freesort_minus_causal_causal_third), 
            by = c("third_item", "middle_causal")) %>% 
  left_join(d_preceding_distances %>% #join similar distances
              rename("third_item" = itemB,
                     "middle_similar" = itemA,
                     "causal_distance_similar_third" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_similar_third" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_similar_third" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(third_item, 
                     middle_similar,
                     causal_distance_similar_third,
                     freesort_distance_similar_third,
                     freesort_minus_causal_similar_third), 
            by = c("third_item", "middle_similar")) %>% 
  
  left_join(d_preceding_distances %>% 
              rename("first_item" = itemA,
                     "middle_causal" = itemB,
                     "causal_distance_causal_first" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_causal_first" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_causal_first" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(first_item, 
                     middle_causal,
                     causal_distance_causal_first,
                     freesort_distance_causal_first,
                     freesort_minus_causal_causal_first), 
            by = c("first_item", "middle_causal")) %>% 
  left_join(d_preceding_distances %>% 
              rename("first_item" = itemA,
                     "middle_similar" = itemB,
                     "causal_distance_similar_first" = mean_causal_distance,
                     "freesort_distance_similar_first" = mean_freesort_distance,
                     "freesort_minus_causal_similar_first" = freesort_minus_causal) %>% 
              select(first_item, 
                     middle_similar,
                     causal_distance_similar_first,
                     freesort_distance_similar_first,
                     freesort_minus_causal_similar_first), 
            by = c("first_item", "middle_similar")) %>% 

  mutate(facet_label = paste0("first item: ", first_item,
                              "\n",
                              "third item: ", third_item,
                              "\n",
                              "causal: ", middle_causal, 
                              "\n",  
                              "similar: ", middle_similar,
                              "\n",
                              "\n",
                              "1st item-cdS,fdS,cdC,fdC: ", "(", 
                              causal_distance_similar_first, ",",
                              freesort_distance_similar_first, ",",
                              causal_distance_causal_first, ",",
                              freesort_distance_causal_first, ")", "\n", 
                              "3rd item-cdS, fdS, cdC, fdC: ", "(", 
                              causal_distance_similar_third, ",",
                              freesort_distance_similar_third, ",",
                              causal_distance_causal_third, ",",
                              freesort_distance_causal_third, ")"
                              )) 

#sort by itemB and extract the ordered facet labels
ordered_facet_labels <- dat_labels %>%
  mutate(first_item = factor(first_item, levels = desired_order)) %>% 
  arrange(first_item) %>% 
  pull(facet_label)

#join labels + order AFTER labels exist
dat_summarized_itemlevel <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  left_join(dat_labels %>% select(first_third, facet_label), by = "first_third") %>%
  mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_label, levels = ordered_facet_labels))

p_itemlvl <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean_proportion, fill = response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "#000000")) + #or whatever you'd like!

5 Primary Analysis

5.1 Logistic regression

##factor outcome variables
d_model <- dat %>%
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("similar", "causal"))) %>%
  mutate(subject_id = factor(subject_id))

##run the model
model_chain_vs_common <- glmer(response ~ condition + (1 | subject_id), 
      family = binomial(link = 'logit'), 
      data = d_model)

summary(model_chain_vs_common)
## Generalized linear mixed model fit by maximum likelihood (Laplace
##   Approximation) [glmerMod]
##  Family: binomial  ( logit )
## Formula: response ~ condition + (1 | subject_id)

## -1.7971 -0.3302 -0.2951  0.6102  3.0283

effects_data <- allEffects(model_chain_vs_common)
effects_df <- as.data.frame(effects_data$condition)
effects_df
